Welcome to the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science
The Department of Mathematics and Computer Science has 16 professorships, currently one SNFS professorship and employs about 150 people in research, teaching, and administration. It offers study programs in Mathematics (on the bachelor's and master's levels), Computer Science (on the bachelor's and master's levels), Data Science (on the master's level) and Actuarial Science (interdisciplinary master's program).
